scenario: Greeting someone for the first time
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa katika utangulizi: 'Nice to meet you'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello! My name is Ana.
dialogue.translation: Habari! Jina langu ni Ana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi, Ana. Nice to meet you. I am Carlos.
dialogue.translation: Hujambo, Ana. Ninafurahi kukutana nawe. Nina Carlos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too. This is my friend, Luis.
dialogue.translation: Pia ninafurahi kukutana nawe. Huyu ni rafiki yangu, Luis.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Hello, Luis. I am from Spain.
dialogue.translation: Habari, Luis. Nina kutoka Hispania.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I am from Mexico. Welcome!
dialogue.translation: Na mimi ni kutoka Meksiko. Karibu!

scenario: Asking where something is in a store
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Mwanzo wa kwanza wa kiburi cha 'to be'.
Jina la kishari kushiriki kuhusu kitu kilichojulikana.
Katika 'over there' maana yake ni 'huko' au 'kwenye upande huo'.
Katika 'right there' maana yake ni 'huko tu'.
Kifaa au sehemu ya kimataifa kuweka vitu.
Katika mazingira ya duka, maana yake ni 'kupata' au 'kupata'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is the bread?
dialogue.translation: Samahani, wapi mkate?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is over there, on that shelf.
dialogue.translation: Iko huko, kwenye rafiki huo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it right there?
dialogue.translation: Iko huko tu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes. You need to get it from the top.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo. Unahitaji kupata kutoka juu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Asante!

scenario: Ordering a drink at a café
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kotoa ombi kwa ubunifu: 'Can I have...?'
Katika mazingira haya maana yake ni 'kunywa' kiuno.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What can I get for you?
dialogue.translation: Naweza kukupa nini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Can I have a coffee, please?
dialogue.translation: Naweza kupata kahawa, tafadhali?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hot or cold?
dialogue.translation: Moto au baridi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hot, please. And what tea do you have?
dialogue.translation: Moto, tafadhali. Na una aina gani ya chai?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here you go. Your coffee and tea.
dialogue.translation: Hapa yako. Kahawa na chai yako.

key_phrases.phrase: What can I get for you?

scenario: Buying a ticket at a station
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuelezea tiketi, kama vile: 'one ticket'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want one ticket to London, please.
dialogue.translation: Ninataka tiketi moja kwenda London, tafadhali.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: For today, with the train now?
dialogue.translation: Kwa leo, na treni sasa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but very early, and then I go to work.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini sana asubuhi, na halafu ninaenda kazini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK, you have the train at six. That is good.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, una treni saa six. Hiyo ni nzuri.

scenario: Checking in at a hotel reception
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
dialogue.translation: Jioni njema. Je, una hifadhi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a room for two nights.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, sisi tuna chumba kwa usiku mbili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your key. Your room is on the third floor.
dialogue.translation: Hapa kuna ufunguo wako. Chumba chako kimeingia kwenye sakafu ya tatu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. We need help with our bags.
dialogue.translation: Asante. Sisi hitaji msaada na mikeba yetu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. How long do you want to stay?
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Unataka kua kwa muda mrefu gani?

key_phrases.phrase: How long do you want to stay?
key_phrases.translation: Unataka kua kwa muda mrefu gani?

scenario: Meeting a new neighbor
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inaonyesha kwamba jambo lilotokea hivi karibuni.
Katika mazingira haya, 'move' maana yake ni kubadilisha eneo la kuhifadhi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I see you just moved into the house next door.
dialogue.translation: Habari! Ninaona umehamia nyumba karibu na mlango.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I live here now. It is my new home.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, sasa ninaishi hapa. Ni nyumba yangu mpya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is great! So, do you need help with your things today?
dialogue.translation: Hii ni jambo la kufurahia! Hivyo, je, unahitaji msaada na vitu vyako leo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe later. Oh, the door is open. Let me close it.
dialogue.translation: Labda baadaye. Oh, mlango umefunguliwa. Nichukue kufunga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No problem. I am at home all morning. Come by any time.
dialogue.translation: Hakuna tatizo. Niko nyumbani asubuhi yote. Karibu wakati wowote.

scenario: Asking the time on the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuweka swali la muda: 'What time is it?'
Katika mazingatio haya, 'Do you have the time?' = Je, una muda?
Katika 'Can you tell me...' = Unaweza kuniambia...
Hutumiwa kuelezea upigi wa muda au muda wa usiku.
Katika 'see you then' = tutakutana wakati huo.
Hutumiwa kwa muda: 'at three' = saa tatu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you have the time?
dialogue.translation: Samahani, je, una muda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't know. I don't have a watch.
dialogue.translation: Samahani, sielewi. Sina saa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, but can you tell me if it's late?
dialogue.translation: Oh, lakini unaweza kuniambia kama ni jioni?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's about three now.
dialogue.translation: Nadhani sasa ni karibu saa tatu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you! See you at three then.
dialogue.translation: Asante! Tutakutana saa tatu wakati huo.

scenario: At the doctor for a basic checkup
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa na majina yanayohusiana na kuwepo kwa kitu chochote.
Hutumiwa na vitu visivyo na kipimo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How do you feel today?
dialogue.translation: Umekuja jinsi gani leo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not better than yesterday. I have some pain here.
dialogue.translation: Sijakuwa bora zaidi kuliko jana. Nina maumivu kidogo hapa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You should take this medicine. All is fine, but rest more.
dialogue.translation: Ingependa kuchukua dawa hii. Kila kitu ni sawa, lakini pumzika zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: How much do I take each day?
dialogue.translation: Ningachukue ngapi kila siku?

scenario: Paying at a supermarket checkout
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Fedha inayorodhwa baada ya kulipa zaidi
Katika 'out of' (ya) – kiwango cha kitu cho chote

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is the total. The price is twenty dollars.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni jumla. Bei ni dola ishirini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK. How much does it cost? Can I pay with a card?
dialogue.translation: Sawa. Inatana ngapi? Naweza kulipa kwa kadi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, here is the card machine. And here is your receipt.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, hapa kuna mashine ya kadi. Na hapa kuna risiti yako.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. I am out of cash, so card is good.
dialogue.translation: Asante. Sina fedha, kwa hiyo kadi ni nzuri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your change. Have a nice day!
dialogue.translation: Hapa kuna mabadiliko yako. Siku njema!

scenario: Calling a friend to make simple plans
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Fala kutumika kwa uwezo au uwezekano.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, this is me. Can you call me today?
dialogue.translation: Habari, hii ni mimi. Unaweza kuniita leo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can call you now. Where are you?
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, naweza kukuita sasa. Wapi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I am at home. Can you see me tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Mimi niko nyumbani. Unaweza kuniona kesho?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see you tomorrow. Where do we meet?
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, naweza kukuona kesho. Tutakutana wapi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Meet me on this street, near the park.
dialogue.translation: Nikutane juu ya njia hii, karibu na ustaarabu.

scenario: Describing your family to someone
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuwasilisha watu wa nyumbani au watu wa karibu.
Inatumika kwa dada, bila kutoa maelezo kama ni kubwa au ndogo.
Inatumika kwa ndugu, bila kutoa maelezo kama ni kubwa au ndogo.
Kiwango cha kuweka nguvu kwa visando.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tell me about your family.
dialogue.translation: Nionye kuhusu familia yako.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live with my mother, father, and two sisters. My brother is not at home.
dialogue.translation: Nanaishi na mama yangu, baba yangu, na dada wawili. Ndugu yangu si nyumbani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is your father old or young?
dialogue.translation: Baba yako ni mzee au mjane?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: He is not very old, but my mother is very young.
dialogue.translation: Hawezi kuwa mzee sana, lakini mama yangu ni mjane sana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And your sisters? Are they young too?
dialogue.translation: Na dada zako? Wako mjane pia?

key_phrases.phrase: live with my mother and father
key_phrases.translation: nanaishi na mama yangu na baba yangu

scenario: Asking for directions in the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the station far from here?
dialogue.translation: Samahani, je, kituo huko mbali na hapa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's near. Go straight and turn left at the next street.
dialogue.translation: Hapana, ni karibu. Endelea nyuma na kugeuka kushoto kwenye mtaa ijayo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Go straight and turn left? Is that right?
dialogue.translation: Endelea nyuma na kugeuka kushoto? Je, hiyo ni kulia?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right. Then go straight again. The station is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, hiyo ni kulia. Halafu endelea nyuma tena. Kituo kuna kulia yako.

scenario: On a bus asking the driver for help
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kushiriki kuhusu kituo cha basi.
Katika mazingira haya, 'kupanda' maana yake ni kupanda.
Kwa kuwasiliana kuhusu njia ya kufanya jambo fulani.
Kwa kuwasiliana kuhusu chaguo moja kati ya mengi.
Neno isiyo na mwisho kwa kuwasiliana kwa msaada.
Neno ya heshima muhimu katika ombi.
Inaonyesha sehemu karibu na mtu anayewasiliana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can you help me? I need to get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Samahani, unaweza kuniusaidia? Nina hitaji kupanda katika kituo cha mwisho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Which stop do you want? This is the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Ndio. Unataka kituo gani? Hii ni kituo cha mwisho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want the stop near the hospital. How many stops from here?
dialogue.translation: Nataka kituo karibu na hospitali. Ni vipande ngapi kutoka hapa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's three stops down. Please sit down, I will tell you.
dialogue.translation: Ni vipande mitatu chini. Tafadhali, kaa chini, nitakukambia.

key_phrases.phrase: get off at the next stop

scenario: Introducing a colleague at work
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea mahali au kazi inayofanyika.
Katika mazingira haya, 'meet' maana yake ni 'kujua' kwa mara ya kwanza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, this is our new colleague. Her name is Ana.
dialogue.translation: Habari, huyu ni mshirika wetu mpya. Jina lake ni Ana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Ana. What do you do here?
dialogue.translation: Nimefurahi kukutana na wewe, Ana. Unafanya nini hapa?

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: She works in our team. He is her manager.
dialogue.translation: Yeye anafanya kazi katika kundi letu. Yeye ni mkenyeji wake.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good! I want to work with you.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri! Nataka kufanya kazi nawe.

scenario: Leaving a voicemail message
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Fundi linatumika kwa kuwasiliana kwa simu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, this is Ana. Please leave a message after the beep.
dialogue.translation: Hallo, hii ni Ana. Tafadhali acha ujumbe baada ya pito.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi Ana, this is Luis. Please call me back soon.
dialogue.translation: Hallo Ana, hii ni Luis. Tafadhali niwite tena karibu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, Luis. What is your number?
dialogue.translation: Sawa, Luis. Namba yako ni ipi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is 555-1234. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Ni 555-1234. Asante!

scenario: At the post office sending a package
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Katika mazingira haya, 'have' hutumika kama kiburi cha kusaidia katika hali ya sasa ya kamilifu

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to send this package to my friend.
dialogue.translation: Nataka kutuma pakoti hii kwenye rafiki yangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have it at the counter. Please fill out this form for the package.
dialogue.translation: Tunao katika kounteri. Tafadhali jaza fomu hii kwa ajili ya pakoti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this all for the package?
dialogue.translation: Hii ni zote kwa ajili ya pakoti?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have all we need. You can send it now.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tuna zote tunazohitaji. Unaweza kutuma sasa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.translation: Asante.

scenario: Describing your daily routine
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Fala kutumika kwa kawaida kwa kusema 'kuinuka katika kitanda'.
Sehemu ya siku kutoka saa 6 hadi 12.
Kwa kiwango cha takriban saa 6 hadi 10.
Kwa ajili ya televisheni au kitu chochote kinachoweza kuonekana.
Kifayo cha kipekee: sleep, slept, slept.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I get up at seven in the morning.
dialogue.translation: Nainuka saa moja asubuhi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I have breakfast and go to work.
dialogue.translation: Kisha nala chakula cha asubuhi na nenda kazini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I work at home in the evening.
dialogue.translation: Nafanya kazi nyumbani jioni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I watch TV because I like it.
dialogue.translation: Ninaangalia televisheni kwa sababu inaongea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then I sleep at ten.
dialogue.translation: Kisha nala saa kumi.

scenario: Asking about opening hours
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea kwamba sehemu fulani inapatikana kwa umma.
Inaonyesha vitendo vya kufungua, hapa inatumika katika hali ya halali.
Katika mazingira haya inamaanisha muda wa saa.
Ina maana ya siku za wiki.
Inatumika kabla ya siku za wiki.
Inatumika kutoa tofauti kati ya habari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the open time today?
dialogue.translation: Unaweza kuniambia muda wa kufunguliwa leo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We open at nine, but we close at five.
dialogue.translation: Hatu fungua saa moja asubuhi, lakini hatu fungua saa moja mchana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And on Saturday, until what time are you open?
dialogue.translation: Na Jumamosi, hadhi muda gani unapo funguliwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: On Saturday, we close at one.
dialogue.translation: Jumamosi, hatu fungua saa moja.

scenario: Choosing a dish from a menu
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you like to eat?
dialogue.translation: Unapenda kula nini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like fish or chicken with rice.
dialogue.translation: Ninapenda samaki au kuku na mchele.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.
dialogue.translation: Samaki ni nzuri sana hapa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I try some fish, please.
dialogue.translation: Hivi jaribu kidogo samaki, tafadhali.

key_phrases.phrase: What do you like to eat?
The fish is very good here.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Neno isiyohusiana na idadi katika Kiingereza: 'money' hauna jamii.
Inaweza kuwa kina (kama 'more money') au kibali (kama 'more quickly').

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Ninahitaji fedha sasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Hapa kuna kadi yako. Nenda huko na kitambulisho chako.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Utanipa fedha zaidi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, nitakupa fedha sasa. Nenda huko.
